subject: design/feature-implementation-drive-argus-approval
statement: Feature execution ownership is an explicit CAS transition over `{domain, stable_owner_id, epoch, state}` (`design-brainstorm:feature-implementation-drive-tech-design#D-2`). The first store adapter uses `refs/pyxis/feature-drives/<feature-id>`; the ref points to a commit whose tree contains canonical `drive.json`. Each successful update preserves the prior commit as its parent, giving transition lineage without making event sourcing the state model. Creation and updates use force-with-lease against the observed object id; a missing or mismatched expected id loses cleanly and reloads.
